title: Connected components of real loci in moduli spaces of vector and Higgs bundles over a Klein surface
summary: Let $X$ be a Riemann surface of genus $g \geqslant 2$ and let $σ: X \to X$ be an antiholomorphic involution on $X$. Let $\mathcal{N}(r,d)$ be the moduli space of semistable vector bundles of rank $r$ and degree $d$ on $X$, with the induced real structure. Using a gauge-theoretic approach, we determine the number of connected components of the real locus of $\mathcal{N}(r,d)$ for general $r$ and $d$.
